note: Rewritten from the original description of the new species (Portuguese) in Rocha & Cancello 2007; the measurements are the ranges measured by the authors, and the original uses commas as decimal points, changed here to decimal points. The measurement abbreviations follow Roonwal (1970): LH head capsule length, MWH maximum head width, HH head height, MLM maximum length of the left mandible, CLM mandible base to tip, MLP minimum length of the postmentum, LT length of the left hind tibia; the alate additionally uses mxD E maximum diameter of the compound eye, ID interocular distance, mxD oc/minD oc maximum/minimum diameter of the ocellus, MLP/MWP maximum length/width of the pronotum, AWL minimum length of the forewing.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head rectangular; in profile the dorsal margin is unevenly, shallowly concave from the posterior third to the level of the fontanelle, and from the fontanelle to the base of the clypeus it forms an almost straight shallow slope. In profile the head is not very thick. The labrum is pentagonal with a rounded apex. The antennae have eleven segments; segment 1 is the longest, segment 2 is half as long as segment 1, the remaining segments are subequal, and segment 3 is sometimes split. The mandibles are short and stout, strongly curved, about one third of the head capsule length, each with a tooth on the distal half, enlarged at the base and thickened behind the base, especially evident in profile. The head is entirely covered with short hairs forming a continuous pile, sparser posteriorly; setae are fewer and mainly concentrated in the fontanelle region. The labrum bears 5—8 setae, always with a longer pair at the apex. The postmentum is covered with short hairs, with a few setae on the anterior margin. The pronotum is covered with short hairs forming a continuous pile, with few setae, mostly distributed along the margins; the remaining thoracic nota bear setae and short hairs only on the posterior margin; the abdominal tergites and sternites are covered with short hairs forming a continuous pile, with erect setae on the posterior margin. Measurements (27 individuals, 6 specimens): head capsule length 1.47—1.80 mm, maximum head width 0.68—0.88 mm, head height 0.64—0.81 mm, maximum length of the left mandible 0.56—0.71 mm, mandible base to tip 0.59—0.74 mm, minimum length of the postmentum 1.01—1.35 mm, length of the left hind tibia 0.54—0.71 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: The antennae have twelve segments; segment 1 is the longest, segment 2 is half as long as segment 1, the remaining segments are subequal, and segment 3 is sometimes subdivided. The head is covered with a continuous pile of short hairs and with many setae. The thoracic nota bear many short hairs and setae; the abdominal tergites and sternites bear many short hairs and few setae, and the last 4 tergites and the posterior margin of all the sternites bear erect setae.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: The head is elongate, slightly concave posteriorly in profile; the compound eyes are large but not very projecting; the ocelli are oval, their distance from the compound eye equal to their minimum diameter; the fontanelle is oval, large and slightly projecting, at the level of the posterior half of the compound eye. The antennae have thirteen segments; segment 1 is the longest, segment 2 is half as long as segment 1, the remaining segments are subequal, and segment 3 is sometimes split. The head is covered with a continuous pile of short hairs and bears many erect setae. The pronotum is covered with a continuous pile of short hairs, with many setae over the whole surface; the remaining thoracic nota have few short hairs, situated between the wing scales. The abdominal tergites and sternites are covered with a continuous pile of short hairs, with setae mainly on the posterior margin. The forewing is covered with short hairs, and the wing scale bears short hairs and many setae. In dorsal view the head has two pale spots above the ocelli. Measurements (12 individuals, both sexes, 1 specimen): head length (to the base of the clypeus) 0.60—0.66 mm, maximum head width (including compound eyes) 0.84—0.88 mm, maximum diameter of the compound eye 0.20 mm, interocular distance 0.64—0.66 mm, maximum diameter of the ocellus 0.08—0.10 mm and minimum diameter 0.06—0.08 mm, maximum length of the pronotum 0.40—0.48 mm and maximum width 0.62—0.66 mm, minimum length of the forewing (excluding the wing scale) 7.06—7.55 mm, length of the left hind tibia 0.80—0.86 mm.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier mandibles are short, stout and strongly curved, of the same type as in Cylindrotermes brevipilosus; it differs in the sparser short hairs on the head, the larger body, and the more gently curved mandibles. The alate fontanelle is, relatively, the largest in the genus and slightly projecting, and the ocelli are relatively small, especially clear in profile.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The holotype is a soldier (MZUSP 11265, Luiz Antônio, Reserva Jataí, state of São Paulo, Brazil, 1997-5-25, collected by E. M. Cancello). The specific epithet caata comes from Tupi and means "hard forest", referring to the cerrado vegetation in which the species occurs. Type locality: Luís Antônio, Reserva Jataí, state of São Paulo, Brazil (21.555°S, 47.7044°W).
